style: Warm, cozy picture-book look for a kindergarten library lesson: soft round shapes, clean outlines, gentle colors.

assets.name: owl
assets.prompt: A friendly cartoon owl librarian called Hoot, standing, front view, round glasses, holding an open book under one wing, soft brown and cream feathers, kind smile, full body.

assets.name: libroom
assets.prompt: Empty background: the inside of a bright, cheerful school library room seen straight on. A warm cream wall with two tall arched windows letting in sunlight across the upper part, a warm honey wooden floor across the lower half. The room is completely empty: no shelves, no furniture, no books, no rugs, no people, no animals, no text.

assets.name: picbins
assets.prompt: Two low colorful wooden picture-book bins side by side, full of picture books facing forward with bright covers with no words, for a school library.

assets.name: ficshelf
assets.prompt: A wide wooden bookcase with two shelves full of colorful chapter book spines, for a school library, front view.

assets.name: nonshelf
assets.prompt: A wide wooden bookcase with two shelves full of colorful nonfiction books, a small globe and a toy dinosaur on top, front view.

assets.name: desk
assets.prompt: A wooden library checkout desk with a computer screen, a book scanner and a small stack of books, front view.

assets.name: rug
assets.prompt: A round rainbow reading rug seen from a little above, with two big soft beanbag chairs, one red and one blue.
